A synthetic attempt record for testing the novelty check: 88 attempts at the public FunSearch online bin-packing
skeleton (a priority(item, bins) function), with invented scores, and 65 labelled probes (exact copies, paraphrases,
renamed repeats, look-alikes, variants with and without a stopper, bug-fix retries, in-flight duplicates, novel
controls). probe_fingerprints.json holds each probe as the classifier read it, so retrieval can be tested with no
model calls. Built 2026-09-28 by the research sweep that first measured the gate.
